profile.applicability: every exported observation type (individual_cycle in the phase table, continuous_recording in the time table); the limits are physical limits of the body or foot, not task profiles
profile.decision: D-UM21-Q01-1 = B (structure plus coarse physical limits, blatant errors only), applied to GT21 as the least-change default; logged in the handoff

L2.evaluated_on: time table (5 ms samples); mapped to phase observations

P1.state: unchecked: per-frame leg-plane geometry is not part of the export

PD.reported_only: flagged and counted; does not change status

profile.no_tuning: L1, L2, L5 are the numbers of UM21-Q01 v3 and GT23-Q01 v2 (asserted equal by the test file); nothing changed to reach a pass rate
profile.population: able-bodied adults (Georgia Tech 2021, 22 participants: level ground, ramps, stairs, treadmill)
profile.status_rule: failed iff L1, L2, L5, S1, S2, S3, S4, S5 fail; L3, L4, P1, PD are reported only
profile.unchecked: velocities, moments, powers, ground reaction forces and the segment-frame pressure point have no limit; ankle angle passes are coarse limits only (zero offset is the D-REF-1 segment-angle difference, unreviewed)
